commands.label: main (1080p30 H.264 + AAC 48 kHz stereo, semitone staircase, drawtext timecode)
commands.command: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=1920x1080:rate=30 -f lavfi -i aevalsrc=exprs='0.5*sin(2*PI*t*round(440*pow(2,mod(floor(t),12)/12)))|0.5*sin(2*PI*t*round(440*pow(2,mod(floor(t),12)/12)))':s=48000:c=stereo -t 180 -vf drawtext=fontfile=/System/Library/Fonts/Helvetica.ttc:text='%{pts\:hms}':fontsize=110:fontcolor=white:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.6:x=(w-tw)/2:y=h-th-80 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -crf 23 -pix_fmt yuv420p -g 30 -c:a aac -b:a 128k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart <TMP>/project/assets/main.mp4
